method.z_segment_screen: At every sampled X plane, all section-vertex Y event intervals are sampled at both inset ends (<=0.0001 mm) and midpoint. Every nonzero vertical solid segment is measured.
method.residual_recording: Every plane records total residual area, component count, classification counts and worst coordinates; every wholly eroded island and every short vertical segment is retained.
method.duplicate_geometry: Exact SHA-identical STL geometry is computed once, then referenced explicitly for every corresponding print part.

interpretation_legend.disk_opening_convex_corner_residual: Expected sharp-corner loss under a round disk opening, bounded by radius-sized box and theoretical quarter-corner area; not proof of a thin structural wall.
interpretation_legend.curved_arch_relief_taper_slice: A high horizontal cut intersects the tapering edge of relief integral with the ceiling. Narrow XY section is retained as a flag; full vertical segment and perpendicular sections are used for interpretation.
interpretation_legend.decorative_groove_upper_lip: A real 0.5 mm vertical groove lip projecting 0.3 mm in front of the continuous 1.2 mm railing core. Detail needs print verification; not described as a >=1.2 mm feature.
interpretation_legend.unresolved_opening_residual_needs_review: Retained numerical flag requiring location/context review. Connected polygon corner/notch/transition loss can exceed the simple corner bound; it is not automatically dismissed.
interpretation_legend.unresolved_short_vertical_segment_needs_: A measured vertical solid segment below threshold outside the explicit decorative lip classification; requires investigation.

limitations: This is finite-resolution numerical screening requiring physical validation, not a continuous global minimum 3D thickness proof.
Features between parallel 0.15 mm planes can be missed. The thin end strip after the final midplane is not sampled in that axis.
Axis-aligned sections can overestimate the normal thickness of oblique walls; three directions do not remove that limitation.
Round morphological opening deliberately flags convex corners and relief taper slices. Opening residual area is not the amount of structurally under-thickness material.
Whole-eroded component means a 2D section polygon contains no radius-0.5999 mm disk, not a detached 3D mesh component.
Vertical interval lengths are directional chord lengths, not general local wall-normal thickness. Decorative groove lips remain recorded below 1.2 mm.
No stress analysis, print, support removal, breakage test, extrusion calibration or physical trial fit was performed.

summary.conclusion: Finite-resolution flags retained for review. See per-axis coordinates and interpretation; no global 3D minimum thickness certificate.
